features.name: Command Center dashboard
features.note: Health home. Widgets for Today's schedule, Action required (pages to review, citations to verify, drafts awaiting approval, drafts not yet scanned per case) and My cases (status, mandate, stale flag, age). Edit layout lets the user rearrange widgets.

features.name: Schedule calendar
features.note: Day, week and month views with date navigation, All calendars toggle, Compare Providers view and Add to Schedule. Linked from the dashboard.

features.name: Structured case registry
features.note: Case list with status tabs (Intake, Processing, Review, Complete, Archived), search by number, name or case ID, status filter, list, grid and column views, sortable columns, bulk selection, Edit case and Open case actions.

features.name: Case creation and editing
features.note: New Case in Health (with mandate type such as CNESST Expertise) and Create case in Legal (mandate tag). Both workspaces share the same case set. Edit case details and Delete case available on the legal case page.

features.name: Cross-case document registry
features.note: All documents across cases with upload, filename search, status and case filters, page counts and pagination (27 files at capture).

features.name: Case file upload with OCR and auto-classification
features.note: Step 1 Sources. Drag and drop or select PDF, TIFF, JPEG, PNG up to 100 MB. ALIE classifies and OCRs each page. Per-file status (Complete, some pages need review), type, pages, size, uploader. Archive, Binder and Timeline views of the case file.

features.name: Case brief extraction
features.note: Step 2 Overview. Extract Brief builds the case brief from the processed documents; workspace automation can run it after OCR without a click. Observed on case 514882885: 'Brief extraction failed. Click Extract Brief to retry.'

features.name: Critical review queues
features.note: Step 3 Review. Three queues: Reports (auto-split reports with date of the event and detected type such as Décision CNESST, Note d'évolution, Expertise médicale / BEM, Rapport de consultation), Unreadable pages needing correction, and Duplicates. Bulk select, sort by date or name, open each report.

features.name: Draft journey tracker
features.note: Step 4 Draft. Shows progress through Sources, Overview, Review and Draft, items still needing review, and sections drafted (1 of 15 at capture) with a resume link.

features.name: CNESST 204 report editor
features.note: Full-screen editor with a section rail: A Worker information, B Physician information, 1 Evaluation mandate, 2 CNESST-accepted diagnoses, 3 Interview modality, 4 Identification, 5 Medical history, 6 Current medication, 7 Factual history and evolution, 8 Subjective questionnaire, 9 Physical examination, 10 Paraclinical examinations, 11 Conclusion, 12 APIPP / DC400. Per-section readiness (ready / not started).

features.name: Section 7 factual history generator
features.note: Writes Section 7 from a dated fact ledger with citation markers [#xxxxxxxx] or [Doc, Page] headers, density budget (about 3 sentences per event), batch continuation, and canonical versions per workspace. Many prompt versions (v0.1 to v0.5.5, FR and EN) in the library.

features.name: Report-Unit Lab segmentation engine
features.note: Masked one-call report segmentation (S6 adjudication heuristics: phone calls, orphan pagination, dated forms, closing formulas) with regime vocabularies for CNESST, SAAQ, IVAC and CIVIL files. Drives the Reports queue in critical review.

features.name: Case Context panel
features.note: Slide-over on every case step: document and page counts, review items waiting, consent status, missing information (injury description, diagnosis, injury date) and quick actions Review, Report, Consent.

features.name: Consent management
features.note: Consent recorded per case (Active consent on file) with a Consent action in both workspaces. Consent revoked and breach detected are critical notifications always sent.

features.name: Prompt Library
features.note: System (151), Workspace or Cabinet (8), Personal (24) and Community prompts with versions, FR/EN filter, type filter, tags (chronology, cnesst, legal, paralegal) and categories Reports, Chronology, Briefs, Dictation, Utilities. Import a .alie-prompt.json bundle or extract text from docx, pdf, txt, md. New prompt editor.

features.name: Prompt Studio
features.note: Agent that builds or revises a prompt with the user from a description or a question. Saved sessions (Create / Revise) and a Benchmarks page.

features.name: Workflows: document classification rules
features.note: Page exists under Main nav to define document classification rules and category sets. Empty state only at capture (No workflows yet).

features.name: Global search (Cmd+K)
features.note: Search from the top bar or keyboard shortcut in Health; Search entry and Search across cases in Legal.

features.name: Messages and direct messages
features.note: Messages panel in the top bar with Messages and Direct messages tabs (empty at capture).

features.name: Notification center and preferences
features.note: Notifications panel (alt+T) plus per-channel preferences (in-app, push, email, SMS in Health; in-app, email in Legal) for document uploaded, OCR or processing complete, generation complete or failed, quality alert, export ready, consent revoked, breach detected, review required, case status changed. Critical alerts always sent.

features.name: Bilingual interface and AI output language
features.note: Display language EN/FR toggle in the top bar and settings, AI output language (Auto, English, Français, Match the document), input language for Ask ALIE (FR-CA, EN-CA, EN-US, ES) and date format (YYYY-MM-DD, MM/DD/YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY).

features.name: Theme: light, dark, system
features.note: Dark mode toggle in the top bar and a Theme preference in Defaults.

features.name: Physician profile and signature block
features.note: Account settings: title, names, specialty, organisation, role, contact, province, credentials and CMMQ permit number, practice address for letterheads, signature text and image (upload or draw), writing style formality, clinic locations (one per case).

features.name: Signature and firm letterhead
features.note: Legal firm settings: capture a signature once (upload or draw) and configure the letterhead applied to exported expert letters: Off, Composed header, or Uploaded Word template, with letter language French or English.

features.name: Security: password, two-factor, sessions, Law 25 export
features.note: Change password, set up two-factor authentication with QR code and backup codes, recent login sessions (date, IP, device), and Export My Data once per 24 hours under Quebec Law 25 right of access.

features.name: Review defaults: highlight colors and chronology columns
features.note: Personal defaults for highlight colors (default, supporting, contradicting, annotation) and which chronology table columns show in the Draft tab (event, date, source, page, citation, critical).

features.name: Workspace members and roles
features.note: User directory with Add User, roles (Platform admin, Expertise physician) and status. 5 users at capture.

features.name: Workspace configuration and report style automations
features.note: Workspace type WS_MEDICAL. Automations: auto-generate case brief after OCR. Report style switches for the Section 7 writer: chronological order, month-level reference, elapsed time, grouping, with a preview of the extract sent to the writer. POC links.

features.name: Billing and plan
features.note: Shows the current plan (Professional, active) and a Contact sales path to change subscription.

features.name: Product tour
features.note: Replayable 5-step orientation introducing the sidebar navigation.

features.name: Account deletion
features.note: Danger zone in Account settings to permanently delete the account and its resources.

features.name: Workspace switcher
features.note: Workspace selector at the top of the sidebar (Demo_Health, Medical) in both Health and Legal.

features.name: Clinical and Legal workspace cross-link
features.note: Legal header carries a Clinical workspace button to health.alie.app; both apps share cases and prompts.

features.name: Mobile layout and bottom tab bar
features.note: Responsive layout with a bottom tab bar (Home, Cases, Docs, Settings) and a slide-in menu on narrow screens.

features.name: Legal Ask ALIE home
features.note: Conversational landing page: ask a question, @ to tag a case, / for commands, attach files, recent conversations, and quick actions Open a patient case, Search across cases, Create a new case.

features.name: Legal case registry
features.note: Cases list with search, grid and list views, mandate tag (CNESST) and sort by updated date.

features.name: Legal case workspace
features.note: Case page with Files, Bin, Chat and Context tabs, add File, Edit case details, Delete case, Share and Consent. Note: opening the Files tab crashed the embedded browser tab twice during this capture; worth checking on a large case.

features.name: Case chat threads with ALIE commands
features.note: Per-case chat (General discussion plus threads) where ALIE works on the case: @ for a file, / for a command, Message ALIE composer.

features.name: Duplicate document detection
features.note: Check for duplicates action in the legal case chat; Duplicates queue in the Health critical review.

features.name: Drafts library
features.note: Per-case tree of generated drafts with a document viewer panel (resizable).

features.name: Task Monitor
features.note: Background jobs running for the workspace (empty at capture).

features.name: Medical chronology generation
features.note: Chronology prompts (chronology_csst_fr_ca, chronology_saaq_fr_ca, Medical Chronology EN and FR) producing dated chronologies with source, page and citation columns.

features.name: Paralegal initial case summary and case brief
features.note: Draft Report prompt 'PARAJURISTE: RÉSUMÉ INITIAL DU DOSSIER' and Case Brief prompts (Medecine Expert case brief EN, Case brief) in the Cabinet library.

features.name: Section 8 dictation prompt
features.note: Dictation category in the Prompt Library (Section 8 v1.0) and Start dictation in the Ask ALIE composer.

features.name: Expert letter export with letterhead
features.note: Exported expert letters carry the configured signature and letterhead; Export ready notification when done.

features.name: Need help entry point
features.note: Need help? link in both sidebars.

patches.name: Ask ALIE
patches.note: Live in both workspaces. Health: case-scoped Q&A over the documents with a citation sources panel, This case only scope, input language, reply language and dictation (Ctrl+J). Legal: home page conversation plus per-case chat with @ file tags and / commands.
